notes:
A medical term composed of ⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (internal) and ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (take, ingest). Contrasts with {外用|がいよう} (external application) and ⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧ (injection). Common in medical and pharmacy contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{内服薬|ないふくやく}→内服薬：22643_naifukuyaku⟧: oral medication
- {内服|ないふく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take medicine orally
- {内服|ないふく}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: oral treatment
- {内服|ないふく}⟦{液|えき}→液：02270_eki⟧: liquid oral medicine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧: taking medicine — more general and common; does not specify the route
- {外用|がいよう}: external application — the counterpart for topical medicines
- {経口|けいこう}: oral (route of administration) — more technical medical term
